statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current evidence supports a low-Tail state while the next concentrated risk window remains the September 23 U.S. open and Flash PMI.
headline: Low Tail after material NQ retracement; September 23 U.S. catalysts remain the next risk window
body: MNQ is near its opening and prior-settlement area after an earlier session high near 30,917.5, showing material retracement rather than persistent extreme holding. Fresh supplementary context shows broad semiconductor strength but split megacaps, while oil eased. Current-hour path granularity does not show verified mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: Tail was predominantly low, with watch readings at 23:00 UTC September 21 and 04:00, 15:00 and 16:00 UTC September 22, plus one elevated 27% reading at 14:00 UTC. Stress stayed high-to-extreme around the U.S. session.
outlookSummary: Overnight Tail stays low unless NQ develops persistent extreme holding or failed retracements. The main conditional danger window is 13:30-15:30 UTC September 23 around the U.S. cash open, Flash PMI and early post-release price discovery.

forecast.analysis: MNQ is near its opening/settlement area after an earlier session high near 30,917.5, so persistent extreme holding is not established. Fresh semiconductor breadth is strong but megacaps are split; the current-hour path does not show verified mean-reversion failure.
drivers: MNQ has retraced materially from the earlier session high
Semiconductor breadth is broadly positive
Megacap breadth is split
Oil eased as Middle East supply-flow conditions improved

forecast.analysis: If early Asian trade remains two-way around the prior settlement area, Tail stays low. A fresh directional break that holds near an overnight extreme with shallow retracements would be the main invalidation.
drivers: Early-Asia two-way trade is the primary checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Absent a new geopolitical or rates shock, overnight rotation would keep Tail low. A synchronized NQ break with broad megacap participation would raise directional conviction.
drivers: Overnight rotation favors low Tail

forecast.analysis: Low Tail persists if NQ continues to rotate rather than extend efficiently. Repeated failed pullbacks would be the clearest reason to reclassify the hour.
drivers: Repeated failed pullbacks would signal mean-reversion stress

forecast.analysis: By this hour, time away from the U.S. close reduces immediate path risk if no persistent extension develops. Background geopolitical and rates uncertainty still keeps Stress elevated.

forecast.analysis: Asian-session consolidation would keep Tail low. A headline-driven gap alone would raise Stress first; Tail would require follow-through with weak retracements.

forecast.analysis: As European liquidity approaches, Tail remains low unless NQ direction begins to align with yields, oil and technology breadth while pullbacks turn shallow.

forecast.analysis: European participation can expand range without creating pathological structure. Tail rises only if directional efficiency persists and retracements repeatedly fail.
drivers: European range expansion can remain mean-reverting

forecast.analysis: If European trade remains balanced, Tail stays low despite high background Stress. Sustained extreme holding with corroborating cross-assets would change the assessment.

forecast.analysis: The U.S. session draws closer, but calendar proximity alone does not justify a block. A premarket gap matters only if it persists with poor retracement quality.
drivers: U.S. session proximity raises Stress more than Tail
